ticket.title: config check reads the config file and does not inherit the suite chain

task.title: config check reads the config file and does not inherit the suite chain

events.description:
Found while proving SP-1 on 2026-11-08. `storypole config check` run inside `common/` prints:

  warning: verification_commands is empty, so `storypole verify` falls back to `cargo test`

That is now false. `storypole verify` in the same directory records `chain_key: common` and verifier `storypole-verify`,
because the store inherits the suite's chains (b3fa899). The audit reads the config FILE directly, so it sees the empty
local list and warns about a fallback that no longer happens.

Two readers of one setting, disagreeing. A user who runs `config check` will open or duplicate a chain they already have;
a user who trusts `verify` will think the audit is broken. Nothing is lying loudly - this is the same quiet shape as SP-1
itself, one layer up.

CHOOSE ONE, deliberately:
  (a) the audit reports the EFFECTIVE configuration and says where the chains came from, e.g. "inherited from suite
      root /path/.gaugeblock/config.toml"; or
  (b) the audit describes itself as reporting the file, and stops claiming the verifier will fall back.

(a) is better because the audit's purpose is to tell someone what will happen when they verify. But it must name the
source, or it becomes the third place where the answer to "which config am I looking at" is ambiguous.

CORRECTED 2026-11-08, same day, and narrower than filed. The single-repo path is NOT broken: `storypole config check`
run inside common/ now reports "1 repositories audited, 0 finding(s)" because it goes through `store.config()`, and the
store inherits the suite's chains since b3fa899. My original observation was made with a binary built before that fix,
so I filed against stale behaviour - the second time this session I have done that (the first was GB-342, the shared
target directory, which was withdrawn for the same reason).

WHAT IS ACTUALLY STILL WRONG, one code path narrower: `storypole config check --workspace` audits each member from its
raw file. `check_workspace` in config_cmds.rs loads every member through `StorypoleConfig::load_unified_or_legacy`
(line 46) rather than opening a store, so it reports:

  common: warning: verification_commands is empty, so `storypole verify` falls back to `cargo test`

That is false for the same reason as before: verify in common/ records chain_key common. The audit is right about the
file and wrong about the outcome.

The reason that path reads raw is documented in the same function and still valid - an audit must not create index
files in repositories it merely inspects, which is why it avoids opening stores. So the fix is not to open stores; it is
to apply the same inheritance to the file read, and to say so in the output: "satisfied by chains inherited from the
suite root" rather than silence when the finding is suppressed.

SCOPE NOW: one function, one output line, and the honesty that an audit reporting a file should not describe what the
verifier will do with it.
